Earth Day slide 1 of 1 Protecting People and the Planet The mission of EPA is to protect human health and the environment - today and every day. Learn more about EPA's mission 1 Follow along as EPA celebrates Earth Day by sharing actions, information, and updates about how YOU can celebrate Earth Day. Learn how EPA protects the environment and builds a brighter, healthier future for all. Countdown to Earth Day with EPA! How many days until Earth Day? 364 Review this infographic to learn more about simple ways to make every day Earth Day. View the Earth Day infographic The EPA Explains series explores topics that the public wants to learn more about! Whether it's a scientific, regulatory, or agency-specific topic, we've got answers. Discover the EPA Explains series Find opportunities and information about spending more time outdoors. Explore how you can get outdoors More than 20 million Americans participated in one of the largest grassroots community service movements in our history at the first Earth Day in April 1970.
